temperature_range: 500 C for TiN, 300 C for Al2O3
summary: The study demonstrates the perfect conformality of TiN and Al2O3 films deposited by ALD. The films were deposited using different precursors and temperatures, with TiN films showing lower resistivity and Al2O3 films exhibiting good refractive index and leakage current properties. The conformality was verified through SEM images and thickness uniformity measurements on 150 mm wafers.
evidence: The TiN and Al2O3 ALD processes used in this work have been described earlier and examined in detail with respect to film growth and basic film properties. Briefly, polycrystalline TiN films were deposited from TiCl4, Zn, and NH3 at 500 C at a rate of 0.2 /cycle and amorphous Al2O3 films from trimethylaluminum (TMA, Al(CH3)3) and water at 300 C at a rate of about 1.1 /cycle. The perfect conformality of the films was demonstrated through SEM images and thickness uniformity measurements on 150 mm wafers.
